findings.body:
**Pass a publication scanner to both default `makePrOpen` calls.**

At `src/ops/dev/cycle.ts:471` and Line 1151, `makePrOpen` receives only two arguments. Its supplied implementation immediately returns `failed` when the third argument, `publicationScanner`, is absent. Thus, both default publication paths push the branch but cannot open a PR.

Bind the publication scanner for the corresponding checkout and pass it to each call.






Also applies to: 1151-1151
findings.title: Pass a publication scanner to both default `makePrOpen` calls.

findings.body:
**Bind stopped-run publication to the successful final check.**

At `src/ops/dev/cycle.ts:1258`, publication uses the newly read head, not the head checked at Line 650. If another process commits gate-breaking U after the check passes at T, a `round-cap` stop bypasses `guardedStop` and pushes U. A configured `pr.open` can then draft U with missing-check gaps.

Pass the final check identity into `finishNotReady`. Before pushing, refuse if the branch, head, or checked worktree identity has changed.
findings.title: Bind stopped-run publication to the successful final check.

findings.body:
**Scan the composed PR body with the publication scanner before each `editPrBody` write.**

Both findings-section writes publish report text without the publication denylist scan. At `src/ops/dev/cycle.ts:1169-1180`, the body is composed from `renderFindingsSection(report, …)` and written with `gh.editPrBody`. The stopped path at `src/ops/dev/cycle.ts:1286-1290` follows the same pattern. Finding and attempt reasons can reach these bodies. The inspected report sanitizer redacts environment secrets and URL credentials, not the repository denylist rules, so a denylisted credential can be posted to the PR. The other PR-body writers scan first: `pr.open` scans `composed` before `editPrBody` (`src/ops/pr/open.ts:444-451`), and `runReport` and `assemblePrs` do the same. Refuse the write on a scan hit or scanner fault. Use the publication scanner that `dev.cycle` already receives.
findings.title: Scan the composed PR body with the publication scanner before each `editPrBody` write.
